# `sense` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "sense" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/sense/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Profile id creatures refer to, e.g. "humanoid". |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (editor and docs). |
| `notes` | string | required | Why these values (tuning band, canon, intended users), for owner review. |
| `sight` | object | — | Sight; absent = blind. |
| `sight.nearRange` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres within which a visible target is noticed at the full detection rate. |
| `sight.farRange` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres beyond which it sees nothing; detection falls off from near. |
| `sight.primaryHalfAngle` | number 0–180 | required | Half-angle of the focused (primary) cone, degrees from the facing direction. |
| `sight.peripheralHalfAngle` | number 0–180 | required | Half-angle of the peripheral cone, degrees; at least primaryHalfAngle. |
| `sight.verticalHalfAngle` | number 0–90 | required | Vertical half-angle above and below eye level, degrees. |
| `sight.darkVision` | number 0–1 | required | How well it sees in darkness, 0–1: 0 = needs light, 1 = unaffected. |
| `sight.detectionSpeed` | number > 0 | required | Multiplier on how quickly sightings build awareness; 1 = baseline. |
| `hearing` | object | — | Hearing; absent = deaf. |
| `hearing.thresholdDb` | number 0–140 | required | Quietest sound it hears, dB at the listener after propagation. |
| `hearing.range` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres beyond which it hears nothing, however loud. |
| `smell` | object | — | Smell; absent = no sense of smell. |
| `smell.range` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres it can smell a scent source in still air. |
| `smell.windSensitive` | boolean | required | Whether wind carries scent to it (downwind smells farther). |
| `smell.tracksScentTrails` | boolean | required | Whether it follows scent trails left by moving targets (hook; post-MVP simulation). |
| `special` | map of string → object | — | Special senses by channel (tremor, life-sense, magic-sense); absent = none. |
| `special.<key>.range` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres the sense reaches. |
| `special.<key>.minStrength` | number 0–1 | required | Weakest signal it registers, 0–1 (after range falloff). |
| `special.<key>.requiresLineOfSight` | boolean | required | Whether walls block it (false = senses through walls and floors). |
| `special.<key>.requiresMovement` | boolean | required | Whether it only senses targets that are moving. |
